status: FROZEN before 2026-12-01 and before the first winter drive; scored before any refit; a refit is a NEW VERSION and the old predictions are kept
language: model-derived; logged readings are 'logged', never 'measured'; no end-of-life; cold outputs NOT SUPPORTED until P1 and P2 hold on winter data

evaluation.cells: each evaluation cell needs >= 10 drives (pairs) on >= 5 days, else 'not evaluable'
evaluation.cluster: calendar day, percentile bootstrap, seed 42, 4000 draws
updateTriggers: a prediction outside its band on >= 10 drives / 5 days
any pack reading below 0 C (first sub-zero data: refit R(T) and the limit map with a curvature term, as a new version)
a change of the logged-share factor by more than 5 points
evaluation.decisionRule: predictions are scored before any refit; refits are reported as new versions with the old predictions kept

params.climateNormalSource: summary_arrays.json seasonalLife.assumptions.monthlyTempC (external, user-supplied, not measured by this study)

P1.name: start-temperature accuracy of the state-model chain on winter drives
P1.rule: free-run MAE of the simulated start temperature <= 3 C and |bias| <= 2 C; park model: held-out bias within +-1 C at gaps >= 12 h and within +-0.5 C around the 10 and 15 C thresholds on winter restart pairs

P2.name: Ah share below 10 C inside the scenario band for the realised ambient
P2.source: analyses/M713/scenario_results_production.json E_real 95 % intervals of S3a, S2, S3b (union)
P2.rule: the day-clustered 95 % interval of the realised winter Ah share below 10 C lies inside the band (computed for the REALISED ambient when it is known); cold outputs are NOT SUPPORTED until this and P1 hold

P3.name: resistance proxy ratio at 0 C
P3.formula: exp(EaR/Rgas (1/T - 1/298.15 K)) with EaR and its bootstrap interval from the state parameters
P3.expected: expected to fail HIGH if the slope steepens below the observed range (one activation energy is an extrapolation)
P3.rule: the winter pulse-resistance proxy at 0 C over its 25 C value lies inside the interval; below the observed range the single-Ea form is an assumption

P4.name: BMS charge-limit register at the coldest probe, SoC 60 %
P4.formula: b0 + bT * T (SoC 60) with the fitted map; envelope from the interval ends (conservative)
P4.label: BMS-reported register, not delivered power; linear extrapolation below the observed range
P4.rule: the logged register at 0 C and SoC 60 % lies inside the 0 C interval; at -10 C inside the envelope

P5.name: Ah per km in the cold, no increase against autumn
P5.rule: one-sided: at matched trip-length and speed class, winter Ah per km is NOT higher than autumn; the hypothesis is rejected when the day-clustered lower 95 % bound of the winter-minus-autumn increase exceeds +6 % scaled to the realised temperature difference

P6.name: peak charge C-rate below 0 C within the limit map
P6.formula: limit kW * 1000 / 360 V / 5 Ah (rated basis, verified:false)
P6.rule: the peak charge C-rate below 0 C does not exceed the limit-map C-rate at the logged temperature and SoC

P7.name: engine-on share rises with cooling
P7.source: prototype thermal_params.json ambientEffects.ambient_lt20.eng (per-drive regression with trip-length and mean-speed controls; association, not a temperature effect)
P7.rule: the winter slope of the engine-on share on ambient (below 20 C) lies inside the interval (points per C)
